presentations.summary: Leader of the Scions of the Seventh Dawn, who has the Echo. She sent you to an Immortal Flames ambush as the Scions' representative, and after you struck down Ifrit she told you that those with the Echo are immune to a primal's influence. She seeks a peaceful answer to the primals, but wants the Scions ready to fight.

citations.title: A Notable Absence — main scenario quest (5.1)

He will not take office until he has secured resources, and sought the counsel of Wrenden, once chief advisor to Lord Vauthry's father. Wrenden would first see him solve one problem alone, and Chai, heir to Daedalus Stoneworks, means to do it with Talos.

citations.title: For the People — main scenario quest (5.1)

citations.title: Finding Good Help — main scenario quest (5.1)

presentations.name: The Missing Mayor
presentations.summary: Chai-Nuzz has taken office as Eulmore's interim mayor, chosen to succeed Lord Vauthry. Before the people he vowed to undo Lord Vauthry's systems, proposed an open forum on the city's future, and named food, its neighbors and industry as the first tasks. Kai-Shirr wants to help build the new Eulmore, and Alphinaud judges it time for the Scions to go their own way.

citations.title: Moving Forward — main scenario quest (5.1)

In the Source, Estinien's memories reached you through the Echo: Zenos has his own flesh back and murdered his father, Emperor Varis, before Estinien and Gaius. Imperial soldiers now fight over the throne, a white-robed figure counsels Zenos, and Elidibus walks in Ardbert's body.

Old Enemies, New Threats — main scenario quest (5.2)

presentations.summary: With the Emperor slain and Zenos returned, Garlemald's course is impossible to predict. In the First, the Crystal Exarch, Beq Lugg and Urianger have made a spirit vessel to carry the Scions' souls and minds home, but it cannot receive memory without the blood of the Allagan emperors. The Exarch is seeking a way, and Lyna has asked to speak with you.

citations.title: The Way Home — main scenario quest (5.2)

citations.title: Seeking Counsel — main scenario quest (5.2)

presentations.summary: Alphinaud urged the Scions to tell the Crystarium the truth of the Warriors of Light, whom its books call sin eaters or worse. As you spoke, Ardbert appeared in the crowd, claiming the star had brought him back, and urged the people to become Warriors of Light themselves. Since Emet-Selch's demise only Elidibus could be behind it, so the Scions watch from afar.

citations.title: Facing the Truth — main scenario quest (5.2)

Y'shtola sees in it what Emet-Selch showed you in Amaurot.

citations.title: Facing the Truth — main scenario quest (5.2)

With Thancred and Ryne, back from the Empty, you tracked him down, and he dropped the pretense: he is Elidibus, enacting the will of the Convocation. He scorned Alphinaud's appeal to Emet-Selch's last words, and Alphinaud believes he seeks the Rejoining.

citations.title: An Old Friend — main scenario quest (5.2)

presentations.name: The False Hero
presentations.summary: Elidibus, who wore Ardbert's face, seeks the Rejoining, and the Scions hope ancient ruins may explain him. Tolshs Aath, chieftain of the Ondo, told you that benthos raiding Ondo and Kholusian stores are raising an army against the finless, and covet ruins newly found deep within the illuminated land. Urianger would call on another's help to reach them.

citations.title: An Old Friend — main scenario quest (5.2)

The great creature will carry you down once his underbelly is cleared of barnacles, a task Urianger cannot do from the surface. Bismarck told you of Ken, a man who made a home on his back, and whom history has already forgotten.

citations.title: Deep Designs — main scenario quest (5.2)
A Whale's Tale — main scenario quest (5.2)

In its central chamber a device showed ancients summoning Hydaelyn, led by Venat, who became Her heart, while Elidibus became Zodiark's. Urianger wonders whether the Elidibus you know is a successor, and Y'shtola stayed behind to coax more from the device.

citations.title: Beneath the Surface — main scenario quest (5.2)

presentations.name: Records of the Ancients
presentations.summary: Y'shtola is studying Anamnesis Anyder while the false Ardbert's words stir the Crystarium. At the Exedra, Elidibus conjured a false starshower to wake the Echo in the people's sundered souls, as Hydaelyn does for Her minions, and hailed them as Warriors of Light. Thancred will shadow him, and the Exarch's memory experiments falter.

citations.title: Beneath the Surface — main scenario quest (5.2)
Echoes of a Fallen Star — main scenario quest (5.2)

presentations.name: Records of the Ancients

The librarian Moren taught you that many in Vrandtic history bore that title, until the Flood made it an insult, and Alphinaud suspects Hydaelyn is the common thread. Helping young Riqi-Tio toward becoming an apothecary, he saw that the wish to help was the people's own.

In the Name of the Light — main scenario quest (5.3)

citations.title: Echoes of a Fallen Star — main scenario quest (5.2)
Heroic Dreams — main scenario quest (5.3)

In the First, the Crystal Exarch means to fuse the spirit vessels with his own crystallized essence and test a sixth on himself. If it works, Urianger says, his soul should merge with his younger self's.

citations.title: Fraying Threads — main scenario quest (5.3)
Food for the Soul — main scenario quest (5.3)

presentations.summary: While the others tended to black-masked Ascians, Thancred sent you to check on Y'shtola at Anamnesis Anyder, but Elidibus spirited her away and set you a trial of faces from your past. Y'shtola suggests reaching out to Emet-Selch's brethren.

citations.title: Faded Memories — main scenario quest (5.3)
Etched in the Stars — main scenario quest (5.3)

presentations.summary: Over Eulmore a second starshower brought an illusion of Amaurot and spectral warriors, heroes Elidibus summons from other worlds. Your airship came down in Amh Araeng, and near the Crystarium you found the Exarch and a wounded Beq Lugg. Elidibus has stolen the Exarch's spirit vessel, and with his royal blood the means to control the Crystal Tower, now sealed by their ward.

citations.title: The Converging Light — main scenario quest (5.3)

With Hythlodaeus's crystal you called champions of your own and beat him. The Exarch stripped him of his power, you restored his memories before he faded, and the Exarch, turned wholly to crystal, entrusted his mind and memories to you.

Hope's Confluence — main scenario quest (5.3)

citations.title: Hope's Confluence — main scenario quest (5.3)
Nothing Unsaid — main scenario quest (5.3)

citations.title: Deeper into the Maze — main scenario quest (6.0)

citations.title: The Medial Circuit — main scenario quest (6.0)

citations.title: A Grave Presentiment — main scenario quest (7.5)

presentations.name: The Vault beneath the Bounty
presentations.summary: Back from the edge of existence and unsure what comes next, you take Tataru's advice to return to adventuring. She names Thavnair as your destination and sews you new traveling clothes, and you recall Emet-Selch urging you to see the Bounty's undersea ruins. Far away, in the Thirteenth, a dark-robed voidsent says it has returned.

citations.title: Newfound Adventure — main scenario quest (6.1)

presentations.name: The Vault beneath the Bounty
presentations.summary: In a tavern of Radz-at-Han you hear of Alzadaal III, a satrap allied with a dragon, who hid a treasure vault beneath the waves with its entrance on an island in the Bounty. Estinien, in Thavnair to train the Radiant Host, has bought a map of doubtful worth and invites you along. A fisher of Akyaali will find a ship, and you set out to recruit G'raha Tia.

citations.title: Bountiful Ruins — main scenario quest (6.1)

presentations.name: The Vault beneath the Bounty
presentations.summary: The expedition gathers its crew. Krile sends G'raha Tia in her place, Y'shtola sets aside her research into travel between worlds, and Urianger joins to study the vault for the Loporrits, who want a treasure hunt of their own. Thancred sits out, wary that too many former Scions together will draw notice, and five of you set sail.

citations.title: Friends for the Road — main scenario quest (6.1)

presentations.name: The Vault beneath the Bounty
presentations.summary: Through traps and constructs you reach the vault's treasures, but in the final chamber Varshahn, the young simulacrum through which the great wyrm Vrtra walks among people, bids you keep your distance. At his word the seal lifts on a device his alchemists made, and G'raha names it a working gate to the void, deliberately made.

citations.title: Alzadaal's Legacy — main scenario quest (6.1)

presentations.name: The Vault beneath the Bounty
presentations.summary: Vrtra tells his story. Five thousand years ago his elder sibling Azdaja plunged through a voidgate in Allag's war and was lost in the Thirteenth, and his own crossing found only voidsent. Believing her beyond rescue, he guards the gate, means to spend the treasure on his people, and lets Y'shtola study it. Elsewhere, a knight in black beside four elemental thrones speaks of war.

citations.title: A Brother's Grief — main scenario quest (6.1)

presentations.name: The Vault beneath the Bounty
presentations.summary: Vrtra turns the vault's treasure to Thavnair's recovery. It will be sold to revive the trading port of Yedlihmad, and all who receive it must give part of their future earnings to an orphanage, the Khalzahl Foundation. Y'shtola studies the gate beneath the Bounty, while the knight in black's war waits, unexplained.

citations.title: Sharing the Wealth — main scenario quest (6.1)
A Brother's Grief — main scenario quest (6.1)

presentations.name: The Road into the Void
presentations.summary: Y'shtola has learned how the device keeps the voidgate sealed, but not how to widen it, and Vrtra recalls that House Daemir once built a man-made voidsent. Their notes likely lie in Sharlayan's restricted archives, and with Fourchenault's backing the Forum grudgingly grants entry. Y'shtola quietly tells of a brother who has given up on his sister.

citations.title: Bridging the Rift — main scenario quest (6.1)

presentations.name: The Road into the Void
presentations.summary: In Noumenon's restricted stacks you find House Daemir's research on the Atomos, a creature that absorbs a planar fissure and can widen it into a working gate. The Daemir built an artificial one, and Y'shtola recruits the Hannish alchemist Nidhana to build another for the gate beneath the Bounty. It will need Vrtra's authority to command the gate.

citations.title: Restricted Reading — main scenario quest (6.1)

presentations.name: The Road into the Void
presentations.summary: At the vault, Y'shtola sends two familiars into the void, one carrying a warding scale. The warded one returns unharmed while the other begins to change, so the scale needs reinforcing. Voidsent break through before Varshahn reseals the gate, yet his heart seems set on the journey, and Nidhana asks for the satrap's family archives to build the Atomos.

citations.title: Void Theory — main scenario quest (6.1)

presentations.name: The Road into the Void
presentations.summary: Cid agrees to build a protective case for the warding scale, enlisting Nero and his data on the Thirteenth, and Nidhana finds the parts for the Atomos. Vrtra still hesitates, until the Radiant Host urges him not to abandon his sister and Estinien vows to follow. He entrusts Radz-at-Han to his people for a time, and guest chambers in his palace become your base.

citations.title: A Satrap's Duty — main scenario quest (6.1)

presentations.name: The Road into the Void
presentations.summary: With the scales and the Atomos ready, Varshahn takes a new vessel built for the dangers ahead, and you carry Hydaelyn's navigational crystal. Beyond the widened gate lies Troia, a castle of voidsent, where Scarmiglione devours its mistress before falling to you, boasting that he is first of Golbez's circle of four. Y'shtola makes the castle your base.

citations.title: In Search of Azdaja — main scenario quest (6.2)

presentations.name: The Road into the Void
presentations.summary: Varshahn's new vessel cannot call across the void to Azdaja, so you question the castle's voidsent. In its dungeon you find the dark-robed voidsent, once Zenos's avatar, sent back to the void when he died. Hydaelyn's crystal purges some of its Darkness, and it takes the form of a woman who asks what a friend is.

citations.title: Shadowed Remnants — main scenario quest (6.2)

presentations.name: Golbez's Archfiends
presentations.summary: For a price in aether the dark-robed voidsent explains her world: the Contramemoria drowned the Thirteenth in Darkness and made its life voidsent, and she is only part voidsent. Y'shtola names her Zero. When Scarmiglione rises again, Zero binds him in crystal, and his memoria shows a knight in black named Golbez, four archfiends, and Azdaja captive.

citations.title: Where Everything Begins — main scenario quest (6.2)

presentations.name: Golbez's Archfiends
presentations.summary: Zero is the last memoriate, able to bind aether in crystal, and she rules a refuge where no voidsent may feed on another. The castle's voidsent say the archfiends lead Golbez's armies and devour the weak, while no one ever sees Golbez himself. Varshahn hires Zero for payment in aether, and a spy flees to warn Golbez.

citations.title: Groping in the Dark — main scenario quest (6.2)

presentations.name: Golbez's Archfiends
presentations.summary: Hearing that a memoriate lives, Golbez orders her killed, and Barbariccia, archfiend of wind, claims the task, asking the captive dragon's last aether as her reward. She descends on Zero's domain, boasting that Golbez lets the dragon live to lure more prey, and invites you to her own. Varshahn agrees to pay Zero from his own aether.

citations.title: Nowhere to Run — main scenario quest (6.2)

presentations.name: Golbez's Archfiends
presentations.summary: On Zero's advice you mean to seal Barbariccia rather than trust her. You fight through her stormy domain and subdue her, and Zero seals her in memoria, though the crystal shows no vision. Two of Golbez's champions have fallen, but Zero collapses from exhaustion before she is paid, and Varshahn suspends the search to tend her.

citations.title: The Wind Rises — main scenario quest (6.2)

presentations.name: Golbez's Archfiends
presentations.summary: Zero lies drained, so you carry her back through the gate to the Source to recover, though she cannot consent. A deserter reveals that only the archfiends may enter Golbez's hidden domain and that he speaks to his minions through staves. Nahbdeen welcomes Varshahn home, and Y'shtola suspects Hydaelyn had a hand in your meeting Zero.

citations.title: Return from the Void — main scenario quest (6.2)

presentations.name: Golbez's Archfiends
presentations.summary: Zero wakes in the Source, a world strange to her, and learns to eat. Varshahn apologizes for bringing her without consent, admits he is a soul in a borrowed vessel, and vows to cross back and free his sister from Golbez. Touring Radz-at-Han, Zero decides it was right to join you.

citations.title: A World with Light and Life — main scenario quest (6.2)

presentations.name: Golbez's Archfiends
presentations.summary: Zero tells how the Ascians taught her people to summon eidolons, how the heroes who bound them in crystal fell to Darkness and made voidsent, and how her mother, a memoriate, held fast. Y'shtola offers hope for the Thirteenth, and Zero keeps helping, for a price. Varshahn knows Azdaja lives, while Golbez and his archfiends plot to destroy you.

citations.title: Buried Memory — main scenario quest (6.2)

presentations.name: The Trail to Garlemald
presentations.summary: Zero has recovered, and you are about to return to the void when Vrtra roars from his palace: he has felt his sister's presence far to the north. The search turns from the void to Garlemald, and Zero agrees to come, since you have kept her well fed. She says Zenos treated lives as tools, and that he is dead.

citations.title: Once More unto the Void — main scenario quest (6.3)

presentations.name: The Trail to Garlemald
presentations.summary: In Tertium you rejoin Alphinaud and Alisaie, helping Garleans recover beside Jullus's restoration effort. They report powerful voidsent from the eastern mountains, and Jullus tells of an outlawed order of reapers who made pacts with voidsent. An engineer agrees to repair a snowcraft to take you there, while Alisaie wonders whether Zenos's former avatar can be trusted.

citations.title: A Cold Reunion — main scenario quest (6.3)

presentations.name: The Trail to Garlemald
presentations.summary: Alisaie patrols the snow against rising voidsent sightings, insisting the people need lasting safety rather than charity. Back in Tertium, Zero accepts a dish from Jullus, though she says she has no comrades and that her place with you is only a bargain. Jullus admits Garleans first rejected the contingent that now feeds them.

citations.title: Kindled Spirit — main scenario quest (6.3)

presentations.name: The Trail to Garlemald
presentations.summary: A horde of voidsent descends on Tertium. Zero refuses to help without payment, then agrees to stand watch for the food Jullus gave her. When a supply unit goes silent she goes out alone and saves two soldiers, then is swarmed, until you and the twins drive the voidsent off. Jullus says he owes her a week of meals.

citations.title: An Unforeseen Bargain — main scenario quest (6.3)

presentations.name: The Trail to Garlemald
presentations.summary: Zero joins you of her own will, moved by Alisaie's kindness, and the snowcraft carries you to the caverns of Lapis Manalis, where a voidgate stands. There you defeat Cagnazzo, archfiend of water, who reveals that what Varshahn sensed was only Azdaja's eye and sends you to Golbez for answers. The gate closes with his death, leaving Varshahn holding his sister's eye.

citations.title: King of the Mountain — main scenario quest (6.3)

presentations.name: Holding to Hope
presentations.summary: Varshahn despairs over his sister's eye, so drained of aether, until Estinien steadies him and Y'shtola notes it never fully succumbed to Darkness. While the twins gather ceruleum to keep Garleans warm, he resolves to keep faith and find her, and Y'shtola says Golbez must be dealt with to free Azdaja. The twins part from Zero, who stays with you.

citations.title: A Dragon's Resolve — main scenario quest (6.3)

presentations.name: Holding to Hope
presentations.summary: As you prepare to return to the void, a light erupts over Bhaflau Isle, above the vault, and a great fiend takes flight. Y'shtola fears the enemy has come for the gate after Cagnazzo's defeat, and she and Estinien go to secure it. You and Zero hunt for word of the fiend, which flew north toward Khadga.

citations.title: Paths Barred — main scenario quest (6.3)

presentations.name: Holding to Hope
presentations.summary: Atop Khadga you defeat Rubicante, archfiend of fire. He reveals that Golbez means to invade the Source so the void's denizens may truly die and return to the Lifestream, and that Golbez and Azdaja are on the moon of the Thirteenth. Meanwhile the vault's gate is destroyed, Cagnazzo and the eye a diversion, and Zero insists there is a better way.

citations.title: Desires Untold — main scenario quest (6.3)

presentations.name: Holding to Hope
presentations.summary: Back in Radz-at-Han you take stock: the gate beneath the Bounty is lost, and Estinien suspects Golbez sacrificed two archfiends to buy time to break the barrier to your world. Y'shtola leaves for Sharlayan to seek another way across the rift, and Zero will come next time for her own reasons. On the moon, Golbez walks alone, with Azdaja trapped above his throne.

citations.title: Gods Revel, Lands Tremble — main scenario quest (6.3)

presentations.name: Galuf

citations.title: A Father's Grief — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: Galuf
presentations.summary: Krile's grandfather, a mage who visited Yak T'el twenty years ago. Gulool Ja Ja brought him to the Skydeep Cenote, and promised to explain what Galuf discovered there once Wuk Lamat ascends.

citations.title: Road to the Golden City — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.summary: Krile's grandfather. Studying the gate beneath the Skydeep Cenote with Gulool Ja Ja, he found it built with unknown technology and leading to another world; a baby came through it, and he raised her in Sharlayan as Krile.

citations.title: Pick up the Pieces — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: Galuf
presentations.summary: Krile's grandfather, the good man to whom her parents entrusted her and who raised her as his own.

citations.title: Leafing through the Past — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: Galuf

citations.title: In Search of Discovery — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: Gnaeus

citations.title: Like Fear to Flame — main scenario quest (6.4)

presentations.name: Gnaeus
presentations.summary: Lord Gnaeus, a magistrate of Garlemald's political council. He can see the merits of Vrtra's proposed trade with Radz-at-Han, and Mettius has called him a traitor for it.

citations.title: The Fallen Empire — main scenario quest (6.4)

presentations.name: Gnaeus
presentations.summary: Lord Gnaeus, a magistrate of Garlemald's political council. With Mettius's consent he announced a trade agreement with Radz-at-Han, which opens the Tower of Babil to you.

citations.title: Bonds of Trust — main scenario quest (6.4)

presentations.name: Mettius
presentations.summary: Lord Mettius, a magistrate of Garlemald's political council. To him the tower is Garlean, and foreigners proposing to reactivate it is an insult.

citations.title: Like Fear to Flame — main scenario quest (6.4)

presentations.name: Mettius
presentations.summary: Lord Mettius, a magistrate of Garlemald's political council. He called Gnaeus a traitor for weighing Vrtra's trade proposal and promised a reckoning.

citations.title: The Fallen Empire — main scenario quest (6.4)

presentations.name: Mettius
presentations.summary: Lord Mettius, a magistrate of Garlemald's political council. You saved him from a warmachina in the wastes, and Jullus's appeal moved him to apologize; he consented to the trade agreement with Radz-at-Han.

citations.title: Bonds of Trust — main scenario quest (6.4)

presentations.name: Zeromus
presentations.summary: A voidsent Golbez birthed by infusing Azdaja with Zodiark's residual aether, named after an ancient hero of the Thirteenth. Its Darkness drove you back to the Source, and Azdaja is now its vessel.

citations.title: Abyssal Dark — main scenario quest (6.4)

presentations.name: Zeromus
presentations.summary: A voidsent born of Zodiark's residual aether, with Azdaja as its vessel. It is risen but not yet at full strength, and the hastily repaired brands hold it back for a time.

citations.title: The Dark Throne — main scenario quest (6.4)
Abyssal Dark — main scenario quest (6.4)

presentations.name: Zeromus
presentations.summary: A voidsent conceived from the aether of the Ascians' god, once sealed within the moon. You sealed it in memoria and freed Azdaja; Zero keeps the crystal.

citations.title: Down in the Dark — main scenario quest (6.5)

presentations.name: Zeromus
presentations.summary: A voidsent sealed in memoria. Zero has sent the crystal with you, a gift for Ryne in return for the Light.

citations.title: Down in the Dark — main scenario quest (6.5)
Reunited at Last — main scenario quest (6.5)

presentations.name: Zeromus
presentations.summary: A voidsent sealed in memoria. You delivered the crystal holding its aether to the First, where Beq Lugg and Ryne hope to use it to restore balance.

citations.title: Growing Light — main scenario quest (6.5)

presentations.name: Durante
presentations.summary: A knight of the Thirteenth who fought for king and country beside his friend Golbez. When Golbez was corrupted, Durante sealed him in memoria and took his name: he is the Golbez you have fought. Misled by an Ascian, he struck down the servant of Light on the moon and unleashed the Flood of Darkness. Repentant, he fought beside you against Zeromus, and Zero urges him to trust in people as his friend did.

citations.title: Down in the Dark — main scenario quest (6.5)

presentations.name: Durante
presentations.summary: The knight who took his friend Golbez's name. He stayed in the chasm rather than intrude on Azdaja's reunion, and Vrtra deems his deeds proof of his contrition. He and Zero will labor to restore the Thirteenth.

citations.title: Down in the Dark — main scenario quest (6.5)
Reunited at Last — main scenario quest (6.5)

presentations.name: Durante
presentations.summary: The knight who took his friend Golbez's name, now restoring the void with Zero and forgoing the aether of others. On the red moon, his domain, he fought Enuo beside you. He theorizes that the barrier between the Thirteenth and the Source is weakening on its own.

citations.title: A Grave Presentiment — main scenario quest (7.5)

presentations.name: Durante
presentations.summary: The knight who bears Golbez's name, roaming the void with Zero for those who would join their cause. He keeps Enuo's memoria safe.

citations.title: A Beacon from Beyond — main scenario quest (7.5)

presentations.name: Tural
presentations.summary: A land where, by a letter Krile found, lies a golden city that someone was commissioned to investigate.

citations.title: Growing Light — main scenario quest (6.5)

presentations.name: Tural
presentations.summary: The New World, where Erenville journeyed. It will soon hold a rite of succession, said to involve the city of gold and the beast Valigarmanda.

citations.title: When One Door Closes... — main scenario quest (6.55)

presentations.name: Tural
presentations.summary: A continent whose communities were unified some eighty years ago, founding Tuliyollal. Word of the Garlean Empire's collapse has reached it, and a warmongering claimant would send its armies to conquest.

citations.title: The Game Is Afoot — main scenario quest (6.55)

presentations.name: Tural
presentations.summary: A far-western continent whose tribes warred until the Mamool Ja's leader united it. Legends of its golden city reached Eorzea on a Lominsan sailor's ship, and you are bound there.

citations.title: The Coming Dawn — main scenario quest (6.55)

presentations.name: Tural
presentations.summary: Two continents, the southern lands of the Mother and the northern lands of Xak Tural, joined by a Yok Huy bridge. Gulool Ja Ja united their peoples into the single nation of Tuliyollal.

citations.title: The Nation of Tuliyollal — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: Tuliyollal
presentations.summary: The home of the visitor Erenville brought to Sharlayan, which he calls a far cry from it.

citations.title: Growing Light — main scenario quest (6.5)

presentations.name: Tuliyollal
presentations.summary: A nation in Tural whose ruler, a Mamool Ja, will soon choose a successor through a rite of succession. Wuk Lamat claims its throne.

citations.title: When One Door Closes... — main scenario quest (6.55)

presentations.name: Tuliyollal
presentations.summary: The nation founded in Tural some eighty years ago, when its Dawnservant unified the warring communities. Gulool Ja Ja, the Dawnservant, is old and wants a worthy successor; four claimants vie for the throne.

citations.title: The Warmth of Family — main scenario quest (7.1)

presentations.summary: Wuk Lamat's brother, off surveying Tuliyollal and consulting local representatives on its policies.

citations.title: With the Winds — main scenario quest (7.4)

presentations.summary: Golbez holds Azdaja on the moon of the Thirteenth, and Y'shtola and Urianger have found a way there: a gate opened from Mare Lamentorum, fed by vast amounts of aether channeled through the Tower of Babil in Garlemald. citations.title: Currying Flavor — main scenario quest (6.4)

presentations.name: The Price of the Tower

Krile pledged the Students of Baldesion's support, and the Forum let you onto the Isle of Haam if you culled its beasts. With Thancred's help you harvested the aether in the tanks once meant for the Ragnarok, to be shipped to Garlemald.

citations.title: Going Haam — main scenario quest (6.4)

presentations.name: The Price of the Tower
presentations.summary: The aether is bound for Garlemald, but the Tower of Babil needs the Garleans' consent. Commander Lucia pledged the Ilsabard contingent's help, though Maxima warned that a lit tower could reopen old wounds. In Tertium many fear it, and the magistrates Gnaeus and Mettius will not see foreigners reactivate it.

citations.title: Going Haam — main scenario quest (6.4)
Like Fear to Flame — main scenario quest (6.4)

presentations.name: The Price of the Tower
presentations.summary: Senatus, a refuge for Garlean dignitaries, survives on the Alliance's aid and resents it. Vrtra, as satrap, proposed a trade agreement: Radz-at-Han's supplies for use of the Tower of Babil and Garlean magitek. Gnaeus sees its merits, but Mettius called him a traitor and left, though Jullus warned it is not safe outside.

citations.title: The Fallen Empire — main scenario quest (6.4)

presentations.name: The Price of the Tower
presentations.summary: You saved Mettius from a warmachina in the wastes, and Jullus's appeal to trust brought him back to the talks. Gnaeus then announced a trade agreement with Radz-at-Han, which opens the Tower of Babil to you. Zero, who once refused a mage and a knight who asked for her trust, now counts Jullus a friend.

citations.title: Bonds of Trust — main scenario quest (6.4)

presentations.name: Chains on the Red Moon
presentations.summary: With the Tower of Babil able to send aether to the moon, you joined Y'shtola there. She and Nidhana are reforging the brands that once held Zodiark into a seal against voidsent, with the Loporrits' supporters behind it. Vrtra has set out in his true form to aid his sister Azdaja, leaving her eye with Urianger.

citations.title: Lunar Rendezvous — main scenario quest (6.4)

presentations.name: Chains on the Red Moon
presentations.summary: The brands held as Y'shtola opened a voidgate, and Vrtra carried you through to the Thirteenth's blood-red moon. In a chasm you found Azdaja, bound by chains forged of Golbez's will, her aether fed to his minions for thousands of years. She says he always visits one place to the south.

citations.title: The Red Side of the Moon — main scenario quest (6.4)

presentations.name: Chains on the Red Moon
presentations.summary: A memoria in the south showed a mage and his comrade who once tried to befriend Zero, and she knew Golbez as one of them. Golbez released Azdaja into the Darkness, which made her his Shadow Dragon. You beat him in a duel, but he made her the vessel for Zeromus, and Vrtra called the retreat.

citations.title: Abyssal Dark — main scenario quest (6.4)

presentations.name: Chains on the Red Moon
presentations.summary: No one is ready to face Zeromus, and Urianger warns the hastily repaired seal will not hold for long. Zero gave Vrtra hope: when a voidsent dies, the souls it devoured can break free. Y'shtola plans to harness the First's Light against Zeromus's Darkness, while Golbez waits for it to reach full strength.

citations.title: The Dark Throne — main scenario quest (6.4)

presentations.name: Light Across the Rift
presentations.summary: The brands on the moon are failing, and Golbez's champion Zeromus must be met with Light. The Ironworks built aether transmitters to carry Light from the First to the Thirteenth, and Zero crossed with you in a spirit vessel. In the Crystarium Beq Lugg gave her a body, and Ryne insisted on helping.

citations.title: Seeking the Light — main scenario quest (6.5)

presentations.name: Light Across the Rift
presentations.summary: Lyna warned that gathering Light at the Crystarium could frighten a world the Light nearly consumed. In Eulmore Chai-Nuzz asked that word of the Warrior of Darkness's plight be spread before he calls an assembly, so you toured the city with Zero and Ryne. Zero resolved to find her own answer in the First.

citations.title: Appealing to the Masses — main scenario quest (6.5)

presentations.name: Light Across the Rift
presentations.summary: Eulmore will not protest, and Runar says the Night's Blessed will not object to gathering Light. At the site of the Flood in Amh Araeng you and Ryne placed transmitters, and Zero drew the Light into herself, fainting before she mastered it. She has gone back into her spirit vessel for the return to the Source.

citations.title: In Defiance of Fate — main scenario quest (6.5)

presentations.name: Light Across the Rift
presentations.summary: With the Crystal Tower charged, Beq Lugg sent Light flowing into the void, and Vrtra flew you back to the red moon as the brands neared failure. He senses his sister deep within Zeromus, and the chasm swarms with voidsent. Zero calls Golbez a mockery of the man who once tried to befriend her.

citations.title: Back to Action — main scenario quest (6.5)

presentations.name: Light Across the Rift
presentations.summary: A memoria in the moon's depths showed Durante sealing his corrupted friend Golbez and taking his name: the man you knew as Golbez is Durante. Misled by an Ascian, he unleashed the Flood of Darkness on the Thirteenth. With the Light and a repentant Durante at your side, you sealed Zeromus in memoria and rescued Azdaja.

citations.title: Down in the Dark — main scenario quest (6.5)

presentations.name: Light Across the Rift
presentations.summary: Azdaja is free, in a new vessel made with one of Vrtra's eyes, and Zero has stayed in the void to restore it with Durante, who keeps the name Golbez. She sent you back with Zeromus's memoria, a gift for Ryne. In Sharlayan the Forum asked Y'shtola for a full report on the void and travel across the rift.

citations.title: Reunited at Last — main scenario quest (6.5)

presentations.name: A Letter from Tural

In Old Sharlayan Krile found a letter commissioning a search for a golden city in Tural, as Erenville returned with a visitor from Tuliyollal.

citations.title: Growing Light — main scenario quest (6.5)

Its ruler, who raised her as his own, will soon hold a rite of succession, said to involve the golden city and the beast Valigarmanda. She wants you at her side, and Krile tied it all to a letter to her grandfather.

citations.title: When One Door Closes... — main scenario quest (6.55)

Wuk Lamat's father, the Dawnservant Gulool Ja Ja, is giving up the throne, and she means to keep it from a warmongering rival claimant. The letter to Krile's grandfather Galuf bears his signature, and Wuk Lamat waits in Sharlayan for your answer.

citations.title: The Game Is Afoot — main scenario quest (6.55)

Alphinaud and Alisaie joined, hoping Tuliyollal's unity can guide Garlemald, Erenville was volunteered as guide, and G'raha Tia persuaded Krile to follow her grandfather's steps. Erenville will arrange a ship, and Thancred and Urianger are bound for Tural too.

presentations.summary: A people who first found a home in the Ninth at Treno, on the Mist Continent, and whose remedy for lightning aether, Sleepless Rhapsody, has been handed down for generations. Treno's mayor Miayli is one of their elders.

citations.title: Beyond the Mountains — main scenario quest (7.4)

presentations.name: The Milalla
presentations.summary: Treno's people, rooted there now, led by the line of the Speakers of eld; Miayli is the latest Speaker. Their ancestral treasure, the key, never answered them, and when Alayla gave it up they gave up their claim to it.

citations.title: Into the Mist — main scenario quest (7.4)

presentations.name: The Milalla
presentations.summary: Treno's people, led by the Speaker Miayli. Their treasured relic, the key, opens paths between worlds; Krile has pledged to support them.

citations.title: Into the Mist — main scenario quest (7.4)
In Fate's Footsteps — main scenario quest (7.5)

presentations.name: Beyond the Barrier
presentations.summary: Inside the dome you reached Yyasulani, Erenville's home, and found it in ruins, as if time had leapt forward. There Sphene, the Queen of Reason, welcomed you to Alexandria. She says she shares the throne with Zoraal Ja, the King of Resolve, only by a bargain, and she begs your aid against him, though Alisaie does not trust her.

citations.title: The Land of Levin — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: Beyond the Barrier
presentations.summary: Sphene led you to the outskirts of Alexandria and presented Wuk Lamat as Tuliyollal's Vow of Resolve and her honored guest. She says the two lands were joined thirty years ago, so time must have run faster within the dome, and she claims to know Erenville's mother but will not yet say where she is. Alisaie keeps a close eye on the queen.

citations.title: A Royal Welcome — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: Beyond the Barrier
presentations.summary: At a farm in the outskirts Sphene showed you how Alexandria feeds itself, its harvest sent up the tower to every table. You cleared lightning-charged fiends fouling the farm's river, and the farmhands told you Zoraal Ja builds up his army while sparing the people little protection. Sphene answered that a ruler carries countless lives.

citations.title: A Day in the Life — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: Beyond the Barrier
presentations.summary: In the outskirts Wuk Lamat found Namikka, the woman who raised her, dying and taken to a medical facility in the tower, yet no one there remembers her. The locals say such memories go to the cloud, and G'raha Tia likens the joining of lands to a Rejoining. Sphene sent you east, where a floating machine turned out to be Erenville's mother, Cahciua.

citations.title: On the Cloud — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: Beyond the Barrier
presentations.summary: Cahciua leads Oblivion, a resistance against Zoraal Ja's conquests, first formed to stop the fusion of two worlds. Her comrade Geode explained the regulators: they spend stored souls to revive a wearer who dies, and they strip everyone's memories of the dead. Wuk Lamat now understands how Zoraal Ja rose from death to defeat their father.

citations.title: Gone and Forgotten — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: Beyond the Barrier
presentations.summary: Wuk Lamat chose to join hands with Oblivion, though Erenville doubts it is truly his mother behind the machine. The plan is to strike when Zoraal Ja, who longs to surpass his father, moves on Tuliyollal again, and to learn his technology meanwhile. Cahciua will take you to Oblivion's headquarters inside Everkeep, the tower where the king keeps to the uppermost level.

citations.title: Embracing Oblivion — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: Beyond the Barrier
presentations.summary: Cahciua got you into Everkeep, a twelve-tiered tower whose ninth level holds the district of Solution Nine, though she still hides where she herself is. Sphene found Wuk Lamat there and asked her to make peace with Zoraal Ja, but Wuk Lamat will not forgive him for murdering their father. Sphene offered to guide you through her city instead.

citations.title: Solution Nine — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: The Queen's Secret
presentations.summary: Sphene toured Solution Nine with you and Wuk Lamat, showing how electrope runs through all things in Alexandria. In a residential sector you met a boy with levin sickness, common among children born in the dome and beyond soul technology's reach. Shaken, Sphene blamed herself and vowed to find a cure.

citations.title: The Queen's Tour — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: The Queen's Secret
presentations.summary: At Resolution Sphene showed you souls sold for credits, and told how a war over electrope, the Storm Surge, ended in a weapon that laid the continent waste, after which Alexandria learned to preserve memory and soul. The king hoards feral souls for war, yet Sphene refused Wuk Lamat's idea of removing him. She began to confide something, then stopped.

citations.title: Her People, Her Family — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: The Queen's Secret
presentations.summary: Bound for the meeting with Cahciua in True Vue, Wuk Lamat spotted a Mamool Ja child with blue scales and Hoobigo features, a likeness to Zoraal Ja she calls no coincidence. The boy led you to a bar, whose keeper sent you on to a man named Tassos, and Wuk Lamat smells a trap.

citations.title: Scales of Blue — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: The Queen's Secret
presentations.summary: Tassos admitted you to the Backroom, Oblivion's headquarters, where Cahciua and Shale told of Preservation, the order credited with interdimensional fusion. Shale found that Krile's earring is a data device, and Oblivion's founders may have been her parents. The blue-scaled boy is Gulool Ja, Zoraal Ja's abandoned son, and he fled on hearing Wuk Lamat vow to kill his father.

citations.title: Gives You Teeth — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: The Queen's Secret
presentations.summary: Wuk Lamat set out after Gulool Ja with you and Alisaie. A blind salvager in the outskirts sent you south and told how Sphene gives her people a home outside the tower and visits them often. Wuk Lamat told her she is the boy's aunt, here to bring her brother to account, and spotted him among drowned ruins.

citations.title: Little Footfalls — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: The Queen's Secret
presentations.summary: In the drowned town a rusty machine barred your way: Ser Otis, lord captain of Alexandria's royal knights, in a vessel nearly four centuries old. He has looked after Gulool Ja, who heard Wuk Lamat threaten his father but still wants to know her. Otis stood aside and asked your help with a meal.

citations.title: Drowned Vestiges — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: The Queen's Secret
presentations.summary: Over the meal Otis told his tale: after the great calamity the young queen died of illness, and he volunteered so that her soul and memories could be preserved, becoming a machine himself. Those recreated from the memories of the dead are the Endless, and Sphene was the first. In Solution Nine, Erenville found old friends who no longer remember his mother.

citations.title: Memories of a Knight — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: The Queen's Secret
presentations.summary: Sphene admitted that the Endless are as much her family as the living, and that preserving them needs vast energy. She asked whether Wuk Lamat's people would become Alexandrians, and Wuk Lamat refused. Then word came that Zoraal Ja marches on Vanguard, so Otis and Gulool Ja began evacuating the outskirts while Wuk Lamat rode to face her brother.

citations.title: At a Crossroads — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: The Summit of Everkeep
presentations.summary: At Vanguard Zoraal Ja revealed that Sphene orchestrated the attacks to take life for her people, and she admitted using Wuk Lamat; she is only an illusion cast on a machine. When his regulator broke and his fleet was repelled from Tuliyollal, he ordered Everkeep's citizens slain for their souls and seized Gulool Ja. Freed from his control, Otis died saving his queen.

citations.title: The Protector and the Destroyer — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: The Summit of Everkeep
presentations.summary: You comforted the survivors in Solution Nine, who now whisper that the king ordered the killings and that their queen is not a living person. In the Backroom Wuk Lamat told Gulool Ja about his father and Otis, and promised he is not alone. As Cahciua thanked you, her vessel began to fail.

citations.title: A Comforting Hand — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: The Summit of Everkeep
presentations.summary: Zoraal Ja has summoned Wuk Lamat to the summit of Everkeep, and the only way up runs through Origenics, where souls are cleansed of memory and refined. Erenville confronted Cahciua for hiding that Sphene is an Endless, and she said it did not seem relevant. He stays behind to keep Tuliyollal informed.

citations.title: Unto the Summit — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: The Summit of Everkeep
presentations.summary: You climbed Origenics, joined by Alphinaud, Y'shtola and Estinien, and found a vast portal over the summit. Zoraal Ja, twisted by the souls he consumed, fell to you and Wuk Lamat, leaving Gulool Ja free to embrace or spurn his legacy. Sphene took the key to interdimensional fusion through the portal and closed it, and Cahciua's vessel went dead.

citations.title: The Resilient Son — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: The Summit of Everkeep
presentations.summary: Shale admitted that Oblivion knew the truth about Cahciua, which she had wanted to tell you herself. The king's authority has passed to Gulool Ja, who does not want it. In Tuliyollal Koana welcomed the boy as family, and Wuk Lamat resolved to stop Sphene, since some of the Endless may be their own people.

citations.title: A New Family — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: The Summit of Everkeep
presentations.summary: Y'shtola reported that Sphene fled with the key through the gate atop Everkeep, which cannot be reopened from this side. The key came to the Source with Krile twenty years ago and was stolen by Zoraal Ja, who used it to fuse Yyasulani with Alexandria's reflection. Krile's earring holds a code that may open the gate in the Skydeep Cenote instead.

citations.title: In Pursuit of Sphene — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: The Unlost World
presentations.summary: With Krile's earring and the authority Gulool Ja inherited, the gate in the Skydeep Cenote opened onto Living Memory, a golden city first built for recreation and now a haven for the Endless. At its Meso Terminal Sphene refused Wuk Lamat's plea. She will erase her memories as a living person to harvest life from other worlds, and the deletion has begun.

citations.title: Through the Gate of Gold — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: The Unlost World
presentations.summary: Cahciua met you in Living Memory as she was in life, admitting she has long been an Endless. Shutting a zone's terminal erases its memories and the Endless made from them, and she asks you to erase them all, leaving Sphene no reason to plunder other worlds. Wuk Lamat agreed, but means to meet the Endless first.

citations.title: Those Who Live Forever — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: The Unlost World
presentations.summary: In Canal Town the Endless live out reunions the terminals arrange, and Wuk Lamat found Namikka there, who raised her after losing a child of her own. Only one in ten of the Endless now has form, for want of aether. Wuk Lamat shut down the Hydro Terminal herself, and Namikka faded with all of Canal Town.

citations.title: In Serenity and Sorrow — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: The Unlost World
presentations.summary: In Yesterland, a zone recalling Alexandria's peace before the Storm Surge, Wuk Lamat met an Endless knight she knew as Ser Otis. This Otis remembers none of what she told him and is busy readying the Founding Celebration. The zone's terminal lies beneath a castle, and Wuk Lamat wants to speak with him again first.

citations.title: The Land of Dreams — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: The Unlost World
presentations.summary: You helped Otis stage the Founding Celebration play, where the memory of failing his queen froze him on stage. Wuk Lamat told him Alexandria endures and that he was a father in all but name to its new king, Gulool Ja. At peace, he asked you to watch over the boy, and Wuk Lamat shut down the Geo Terminal.

citations.title: A Knight of Alexandria — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: The Unlost World
presentations.summary: Cahciua led you to Asyle Volcane, the sanctuary of the strong, whose terminal lies through the caverns. In its arena Krile met a couple who knew her earring at once: Robor and Alayla, her father and mother, who embraced their daughter. Krile wonders whether the system arranged this reunion too.

citations.title: The Sanctuary of the Strong — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: The Unlost World
presentations.summary: Over ice cream Krile's parents told their story. The key is a relic of their people, the Milalla, who fled a frozen homeland with it; when lightning came they failed to invoke it, then defected from Preservation on learning it meant to plunder other worlds. They sent Krile to the Source to save her from experiments on her gift.

citations.title: The Taste of Family — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: The Unlost World
presentations.summary: In the Milalla's recreated homeland Krile learned that Preservation opened a portal with the key but never understood it, and that Sphene now seeks to wield it for those she loves. Her parents had long wanted to erase themselves before their knowledge was misused. They called her Maya, the name they gave her, and Krile shut down the Pyro Terminal.

citations.title: Leafing through the Past — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: The Last Terminal
presentations.summary: With leeway left at the Meso Terminal, Cahciua led you to Windspath Gardens, the last zone. She is Erenville's mother and mentor, and she had two wishes before she died: to see who her son would become, now granted, and to see nature she never saw. Erenville balks, knowing she means to leave once it is done.

citations.title: An Explorer's Delight — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: The Last Terminal
presentations.summary: Scouting Windspath Gardens for Cahciua, you learned she met Galuf when he came to Tural seeking the golden city, cradling the baby who would be Krile. His tales of Sharlayan's gleaners are why she urged Erenville to become one. She then took Erenville and you to fly at the Cleyra Museum of Nature.

citations.title: In Search of Discovery — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: The Last Terminal
presentations.summary: After the flight Cahciua said goodbye: her existence is unnatural, endured only to unmake this place, and now she can entrust her mission to you. Erenville promised to carry on what she began and shut down the Aero Terminal himself. The Meso Terminal has entered the final phase of world bridging, and you wait for it to become vulnerable.

citations.title: A Journey Never-ending — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: The Last Terminal
presentations.summary: Cahciua's program sent your souls into the Meso Terminal, where Sphene's living memories were erased and she became a terrifying entity. You defeated her, and she returned from her Endless memories to apologize and leave her people to Wuk Lamat. The terminal went dark and the Endless departed, Gulool Ja is now king with Wuk Lamat as guardian, and the Scions keep the key.

citations.title: Dawntrail — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: Wayakkwe
presentations.summary: A member of Oblivion who fought off a murderous drone in Isadora and Milos's home.

citations.title: Targeted Tragedy — main scenario quest (7.3)

presentations.name: Wayakkwe
presentations.summary: A member of Oblivion, mourning Geode, who was an older brother to her and Nostalgia.

citations.title: My Memories and Yours — main scenario quest (7.3)

presentations.name: Nostalgia
presentations.summary: A member of Oblivion who brought word that a citizen had been killed by a rogue mechanical soldier.

citations.title: Seekers of Eternity — main scenario quest (7.2)

presentations.name: Nostalgia
presentations.summary: A member of Oblivion, mourning Geode, who has vowed to stop Calyx for all who believed in Oblivion.

citations.title: My Memories and Yours — main scenario quest (7.3)

presentations.name: Isadora
presentations.summary: Milos's mother, who once hoped he might be made Endless. Wanting to grow old with him as his mother, she gave up her regulator for his sake.

citations.title: Shared Paths — main scenario quest (7.2)

presentations.name: Isadora
presentations.summary: Milos's mother, gravely hurt when a drone attacked their home and healed by Sphene.

citations.title: Targeted Tragedy — main scenario quest (7.3)

presentations.name: Milos
presentations.summary: Isadora's son, who has the condition Sphene once had. Alisaie's treatment let him speak again.

citations.title: Shared Paths — main scenario quest (7.2)

presentations.name: Mahuwsa
presentations.summary: An Alexandrian who joined Oblivion's fight with her neighbors. She told Sphene that, whatever her likeness to the late queen, she is one of them.

citations.title: One of Our Own — main scenario quest (7.3)

presentations.name: Mahuwsa
presentations.summary: A fieldworker who knows of Sphene's return. She thanked you for stopping Calyx, and has heard the queen who urged them to become Endless was an impostor.

citations.title: Blades in Waiting — main scenario quest (7.3)

presentations.name: Shepetto
presentations.summary: Hhwato's son, who has been looking into why the rroneek are pushing west toward the railroad.

citations.title: Guidance of the Hhetso — main scenario quest (7.1)

presentations.name: Shepetto
presentations.summary: Hhwato's son, who named the beast behind the herds' drift: a tturuhhetso, or rroneek reaver.

citations.title: Guidance of the Hhetso — main scenario quest (7.1)
The Warmth of Family — main scenario quest (7.1)

presentations.name: The Hhetsarro
presentations.summary: A people of Shaaloani whose territory holds the timber the railway needs for its repairs; the stationmaster must ask their permission first.

citations.title: On Track (Dawntrail) — main scenario quest (7.0)

presentations.name: The Hhetsarro
presentations.summary: Herders of Shaaloani who live with the rroneek, led by Hhwato. Their herds are pushing west toward the railroad, and they found nothing wrong with the grazing to explain it. Koana is of their blood.

citations.title: Guidance of the Hhetso — main scenario quest (7.1)

presentations.name: The Hhetsarro
presentations.summary: Herders who would never cage the rroneek. A reaver troubled their herds until you and Koana slew it, and a Hhetsarro trader's tale told Koana what became of his parents.

citations.title: The Warmth of Family — main scenario quest (7.1)

presentations.name: Gossan
presentations.summary: Former chief aide to Queen Sphene, administering Alexandria's affairs of state since her death. At her funeral he credited her with bringing the people together.

citations.title: Alexandria Mourns — main scenario quest (7.1)

presentations.name: Gossan
presentations.summary: Alexandria's chief aide, who now insists the funeral honored those lost in the attack, not the queen.

citations.title: Crossroads — main scenario quest (7.1)

presentations.name: Gossan
presentations.summary: Alexandria's chief aide. Torn between fear of death and his duties, he wore an unregistered neo regulator, then removed it, saying the government must guide its people.

citations.title: One of Our Own — main scenario quest (7.3)

presentations.name: Gossan
presentations.summary: Alexandria's chief aide. With you he restored the people's memories of the dead, and told Sphene the people insist she take her rightful place as queen.

citations.title: The Promise of Tomorrow — main scenario quest (7.3)

presentations.name: Gossan
presentations.summary: Alexandria's chief aide, serving Queen Sphene, who had stern words for her unannounced trip across the Mist Continent.

citations.title: Into the Mist — main scenario quest (7.4)

presentations.name: Teeshal Ja
presentations.summary: A Mamool Ja whom Zoraal Ja set to aid Kanilokka's project and report on it, in exchange for a boon. She may be Gulool Ja's mother.

citations.title: In Search of the Past — main scenario quest (7.1)

presentations.name: Teeshal Ja
presentations.summary: The Yuweyawata facility's Administrator of Experimental Treatments, whose encrypted research logs Shale is processing. She may be Gulool Ja's mother.

citations.title: Among the Abandoned — main scenario quest (7.1)
In Search of the Past — main scenario quest (7.1)

presentations.name: Teeshal Ja
presentations.summary: Gulool Ja's mother. Her audio diaries tell of her hopes of aiding Zoraal Ja in the rite of succession, and of his rejection of their son.

citations.title: Crossroads — main scenario quest (7.1)

presentations.name: Kanilokka
presentations.summary: A researcher who, as an Echo showed, proposed moving human souls into bestial vessels, with Zoraal Ja's approval.

citations.title: In Search of the Past — main scenario quest (7.1)

presentations.name: Yuweyawata
presentations.summary: A region where, nearly twenty years ago, Zoraal Ja fought a tural vidraal and a secret research facility was built on his order. You broke through the abandoned facility and brought down the beast.

citations.title: In Search of the Past — main scenario quest (7.1)

presentations.name: Yuweyawata
presentations.summary: A region whose abandoned research facility held Teeshal Ja's research logs. Its warnings point to the failing seal on the tural vidraal.

citations.title: Among the Abandoned — main scenario quest (7.1)

presentations.name: Sphene
presentations.summary: The original, still-living Queen Sphene of Alexandria, from whom the Endless Sphene was created. Found in Living Memory after four centuries in cold stasis, paralyzed by lightning aether until Y'shtola and Alisaie treated her, she is learning all that has happened.

citations.title: A Glimmer of the Past — main scenario quest (7.2)

presentations.name: Sphene
presentations.summary: The original Queen Sphene, woken after four hundred years. She hides her face and name in the city, uneasy at souls treated as a resource. Glad that Alexandria endured, she feels lonely in it.

citations.title: Memories of a Bygone Age — main scenario quest (7.2)

presentations.name: Sphene
presentations.summary: The original Queen Sphene. She knows Calyx as Preservation's founder, and sees the Endless Sphene as a version of herself who made choices she hopes she never would. Her long slumber has sapped her healing magic.

citations.title: A Jewel Shattered — main scenario quest (7.2)

presentations.name: Sphene
presentations.summary: The original Queen Sphene. In the old castle beneath Everkeep she helped destroy the machine Calyx built in Zelenia's likeness, grateful that her knight's memory was spared further disgrace.

citations.title: Descent to the Foundation — main scenario quest (7.2)

presentations.name: Sphene
presentations.summary: The original Queen Sphene, keeping the tiara that holds the Endless Sphene's memories. Seeing the boy Milos cured, she resolved to forge her own path, honoring her other self's memory.

citations.title: Shared Paths — main scenario quest (7.2)

presentations.name: Sphene
presentations.summary: The original Queen Sphene, determined to protect Alexandria's people after the machines' rampage. She thinks the key is best left in your care.

citations.title: Seekers of Eternity — main scenario quest (7.2)

presentations.name: Sphene
presentations.summary: The original Queen Sphene. She remembers Calyx from her own age, and her retrained magic saved Isadora when soldiers struck the residential radii.

citations.title: Targeted Tragedy — main scenario quest (7.3)

presentations.name: Sphene
presentations.summary: The original Queen Sphene, making rounds in the outskirts. She warns that Calyx holds the core system, and says she is not her people's queen.

citations.title: A Darkness in the Heart — main scenario quest (7.3)

presentations.name: Sphene
presentations.summary: The original Queen Sphene. She knew Calyx as a sickly boy, and lost both her parents to the war's violence. Wuk Lamat has offered her friendship.

citations.title: Preservation Their Purpose — main scenario quest (7.3)

presentations.name: Sphene
presentations.summary: The original Queen Sphene, resolved to fight Calyx at the Meso Terminal. Mahuwsa told her she is an Alexandrian whatever her likeness to the late queen, and she showed her face and promised to return.

citations.title: One of Our Own — main scenario quest (7.3)

presentations.name: Sphene
presentations.summary: The original Queen Sphene. At the Meso Terminal she broadcast a message of hope that broke the prayers feeding Calyx's primal, and helped Wuk Lamat shatter the shield around his memories.

citations.title: A Terminal Invitation — main scenario quest (7.3)

presentations.name: Sphene
presentations.summary: The original Queen Sphene, praised for her speech. She fears speaking with those unaware of her return would do more harm than good.

citations.title: Blades in Waiting — main scenario quest (7.3)

presentations.name: Sphene
presentations.summary: Queen of Reason of Alexandria. The people insisted she take her rightful place, and she accepted, with peace and prosperity as her foremost purpose. Her kingdom will engage more openly with the other nations of Etheirys.

citations.title: The Promise of Tomorrow — main scenario quest (7.3)

presentations.name: Sphene
presentations.summary: A woman of Alexandria who awoke a stranger in her own land. She thanks you for your kindness to her and to Alexandria, and for curing the ailment that tormented her people for centuries.

citations.title: With the Winds — main scenario quest (7.4)

presentations.name: Sphene
presentations.summary: The queen of Alexandria. She recalls the Mist Continent left in ruins by the Storm Surge, with Alexandria the only nation to survive, though some few souls ventured beyond its barrier, and she led the descent from Living Memory to look for them.

citations.title: Through the Thunder — main scenario quest (7.4)

presentations.name: Sphene
presentations.summary: The queen of Alexandria. Finding no survivors at the crater where her city stood, she led you to Treno, and told its mayor that Alexandria survives in a distant land.

citations.title: Through the Thunder — main scenario quest (7.4)
Beyond the Mountains — main scenario quest (7.4)

presentations.name: Sphene
presentations.summary: The queen of Alexandria, who told Miayli of the key. She knew the Doomtrain from Zelenia's accounts as a war vehicle of Lindblum, and went with Eyaney to repair Treno's barrier, offering her knowledge of electrope.

citations.title: Toward Trouble — main scenario quest (7.4)

presentations.name: Sphene
presentations.summary: The queen of Alexandria, back from Treno. Her aide Gossan scolded her unannounced absence; she answered with the chance to resume relations with Treno, a longtime ally.

citations.title: Into the Mist — main scenario quest (7.4)

presentations.name: The entity wearing Sphene's face
presentations.summary: A woman who appeared in Praxis Park as Queen Sphene, offering five thousand citizens Endless life through neo regulators. You and Wuk Lamat suspect deception, but the people remember no death.

citations.title: Crossroads — main scenario quest (7.1)

presentations.name: The simulant
presentations.summary: The impostor queen, named a simulant after imitation stones. She is seen around the city urging the people to become Endless.

citations.title: Memories of a Bygone Age — main scenario quest (7.2)
A Glimmer of the Past — main scenario quest (7.2)

presentations.name: The simulant
presentations.summary: An impostor queen who lured you into a trap to demand the key to interdimensional fusion, and told the original Sphene that the people regard her, not Sphene, as queen.

citations.title: A Jewel Shattered — main scenario quest (7.2)

presentations.name: The simulant
presentations.summary: An impostor queen working with Calyx. In the old castle she set a reconstruction of Zelenia against you.

citations.title: Descent to the Foundation — main scenario quest (7.2)

presentations.name: The simulant
presentations.summary: An impostor queen whom Calyx likely made from a tiara holding the Endless Sphene's memories. With the tiara in safe keeping, Shale expects no more simulants.

citations.title: Shared Paths — main scenario quest (7.2)

presentations.name: Calyx
presentations.summary: Founder of Preservation, a scientific collective that sought a cure for Alexandria's paralysis. Speaking from a monitor, he demands the key and says his goal is mankind's next evolution.

citations.title: A Jewel Shattered — main scenario quest (7.2)

presentations.name: Calyx
presentations.summary: Founder of Preservation, who gave up his flesh long ago. He tested your strength beneath Everkeep, and covets the key to harvest aether from reflections for a growing population of Endless, an evolution he would offer the Source as well.

citations.title: Descent to the Foundation — main scenario quest (7.2)

presentations.name: Calyx
presentations.summary: Founder of Preservation, who lived in the age of the Storm Surge. He can seize Alexandria's machines at will, used the simulant to sell the Endless, and promised eternal life to five thousand who register neo regulators; the people without regulators were the ones attacked.

citations.title: Targeted Tragedy — main scenario quest (7.3)

presentations.name: Calyx
presentations.summary: Preservation's founder, harvesting aether from Alexandrians to convert five thousand into Endless. The reflections are closed to him without the key, so he offered to halt the harvest in exchange for it.

citations.title: The Endless Choice — main scenario quest (7.3)

presentations.name: Calyx
presentations.summary: A child prodigy who founded Preservation at eleven and later preserved his memories in a virtual domain. Researchers who shared his philosophy became Endless.

presentations.name: Calyx

presentations.name: Children Left Behind
presentations.summary: Tuliyollal is at peace, and its Dawnservants, Wuk Lamat and Koana, have summoned you and the former Scions. A state funeral for Queen Sphene is to be held in Solution Nine, following rites Oblivion found in old records. Wuk Lamat will attend for the young King Gulool Ja's sake and to close this chapter, with you and your allies keeping watch.

citations.title: A Royal Invitation — main scenario quest (7.1)

presentations.name: Children Left Behind
presentations.summary: At the funeral in Praxis Park, Gossan, the late queen's chief aide who now runs the affairs of state, spoke of an Alexandria born from the union of its peoples. Some mourners talk of moving to Tuliyollal. Gulool Ja then confided that the records list only two Mamool Ja, himself and his father, and everyone agreed to help him find his mother.

citations.title: Alexandria Mourns — main scenario quest (7.1)

presentations.name: Children Left Behind
presentations.summary: Questioning folk inside the dome and out, you learned that Zoraal Ja once fought a tural vidraal in Yuweyawata with Landsguard, one of them a female Mamool Ja. In the ruined research facility there, an Echo showed him approving Kanilokka's plan to move human souls into beasts and setting Teeshal Ja to aid it. She may be the mother Gulool Ja seeks.

citations.title: In Search of the Past — main scenario quest (7.1)

presentations.name: Children Left Behind
presentations.summary: The Yuweyawata facility held more: its warnings point to the failing seal on the tural vidraal, and its terminal held research logs by Teeshal Ja, Administrator of Experimental Treatments. Gulool Ja copied them for Shale, who needs time to decrypt them. G'raha Tia notes that the authorities must be told what the facility contains.

citations.title: Among the Abandoned — main scenario quest (7.1)

presentations.name: Children Left Behind
presentations.summary: While Shale works on the logs, Geode reports that mostly the young are leaving Alexandria for Tural, and the Xak Tural railroad is not yet running. The rroneek herds are drifting west toward its tracks for no clear reason. At the Hhetsarro camp, Koana revealed he is of Hhetsarro blood, left behind as a babe during a migration and later adopted by the Dawnservant.

citations.title: Guidance of the Hhetso — main scenario quest (7.1)

presentations.name: Children Left Behind
presentations.summary: A rroneek reaver, a tturuhhetso, lay behind the herds' drift, and Koana broke the aether guarding its scales so you could slay it. A trader's tale showed that a reaver likely orphaned Koana, and that his parents never abandoned him. His idea of an aetherial whistle put the Xak Tural railroad back in service.

citations.title: The Warmth of Family — main scenario quest (7.1)

presentations.name: Children Left Behind
presentations.summary: Teeshal Ja's audio diaries revealed that Gulool Ja is her son by Zoraal Ja, who rejected the child. Back in Praxis Park, a woman wearing Sphene's face offered to make five thousand citizens Endless through neo regulators, and those wearing regulators no longer remember the queen's death. Y'shtola, meanwhile, has taken her investigation into Living Memory.

citations.title: Crossroads — main scenario quest (7.1)

presentations.name: The Queen Who Slept
presentations.summary: Y'shtola and Shale found a living woman wandering Living Memory: the original Queen Sphene, from whom the Endless Sphene was made, kept in cold stasis for four centuries. Alisaie and Y'shtola eased the lightning aether that paralyzed her, and the party told her all that had happened. Wuk Lamat stays in Alexandria until the new Sphene's mystery is solved.

citations.title: A Glimmer of the Past — main scenario quest (7.2)

presentations.name: The Queen Who Slept
presentations.summary: To tell them apart, the original is now simply Sphene, the late queen the Endless Sphene, and the impostor a simulant. Sphene keeps her face and name hidden in the city, and on a tour of Solution Nine she voiced unease at souls treated as a resource. Glad that Alexandria endured, she still feels lonely.

citations.title: Memories of a Bygone Age — main scenario quest (7.2)

presentations.name: The Queen Who Slept
presentations.summary: Sphene, Wuk Lamat and Gulool Ja helped Malachite, an usher who quietly returns the belongings of the dead to their families, though the rules say to dispose of them. Delivering his keepsakes, you met Lithander, a former fighter who now helps those hurt when the mechanical soldiers malfunctioned.

citations.title: In Search of Meaning — main scenario quest (7.2)

presentations.name: The Queen Who Slept
presentations.summary: The keepsakes met mixed feelings, and Malachite wishes the memories taken from the people could be returned. The simulant then lured you into a trap and demanded the key to interdimensional fusion, while Calyx spoke from a monitor of mankind's next evolution. Sphene knows him as the founder of Preservation, a collective that sought a cure for her people's paralysis.

citations.title: A Jewel Shattered — main scenario quest (7.2)

presentations.name: Beneath Everkeep
presentations.summary: In the Backroom the party weighed Calyx's aims: Preservation would use the key to make more Endless, and Calyx knows exactly how much aether each needs. Shale traced his transmission to a Preservation terminal in Everkeep's foundation sector, built over the old castle, though she suspects he wanted it found. Sphene asked to come along.

citations.title: The Meeting — main scenario quest (7.2)

presentations.name: Beneath Everkeep
presentations.summary: Shale guided you into Everkeep's depths, where Calyx tested your strength in the old castle. In the throne room he and the simulant set a reconstruction of Zelenia, once second-in-command of the royal knights, against you, and Sphene begged your aid in destroying it. Calyx declared he covets the key to harvest aether from the reflections for the Endless, and left a tiara behind.

citations.title: Descent to the Foundation — main scenario quest (7.2)

presentations.name: Beneath Everkeep
presentations.summary: The tiara holds the Endless Sphene's memories, which Calyx likely used to make the simulant, so Sphene keeps it. Your allies are treating levin sickness, and Isadora gave up her regulator so her son Milos could be cured. Seeing him speak again, Sphene resolved to forge her own path rather than her other self's.

citations.title: Shared Paths — main scenario quest (7.2)

presentations.name: Beneath Everkeep
presentations.summary: An announcement ended the handout of neo regulators and promised that Alexandrians would rise above death as Endless. Machines then ran amok across Solution Nine and the outskirts, killing citizens and leaving no bodies behind, until they stopped all at once. Gulool Ja has disarmed the soldiers, Oblivion watches the machines, and Calyx's whereabouts are unknown.

citations.title: Seekers of Eternity — main scenario quest (7.2)

presentations.name: The Harvest of Five Thousand
presentations.summary: Calyx can seize Alexandria's machines at will, and wants the key to draw aether from the reflections. On patrol with Geode you found that the victims of the attacks wore no regulators, and their bodies left only dust. Soldiers then struck the residential radii, where Sphene healed Isadora but an Oblivion member fell defending the lobby.

citations.title: Targeted Tragedy — main scenario quest (7.3)

presentations.name: The Harvest of Five Thousand
presentations.summary: Searching for Geode, who stopped answering, you found only dust and his soul cell: the machines drain the aether of the bodies they kill. Through a sentry, Calyx said the aether of seven percent of the people will make five thousand Endless, and offered to halt the harvest for the key. Sphene insists it must never be his.

citations.title: The Endless Choice — main scenario quest (7.3)

presentations.name: The Harvest of Five Thousand
presentations.summary: Oblivion mourns Geode. At Earthen Sky Shale told how Cahciua, already dead, recruited her and Geode to protect the outside world from Zoraal Ja, and how they found the abandoned Backroom and took up Oblivion's work. Krile learned her parents' cause lived on in it, and Shale and Nostalgia vowed to bring Calyx down.

citations.title: My Memories and Yours — main scenario quest (7.3)

presentations.name: The Harvest of Five Thousand
presentations.summary: Shale is going back through the data of Krile's parents, the first to break from Preservation. In the outskirts the neo regulator rush neared its limit of five thousand, and a broadcast from Living Memory urged everyone to become Endless. Calyx holds the core system, so Wuk Lamat is arranging evacuations to Tuliyollal with the Landsguard.

citations.title: A Darkness in the Heart — main scenario quest (7.3)

presentations.name: The Harvest of Five Thousand
presentations.summary: Shale found a Preservation laboratory on Everkeep's tenth level, falsely registered as a distribution center. Its records say Calyx founded Preservation as an eleven-year-old prodigy and later preserved his memories in a virtual domain, and that researchers who shared his views became Endless. Within its walls, Wuk Lamat and Sphene promised to stand by each other.

citations.title: Preservation Their Purpose — main scenario quest (7.3)

presentations.name: The Fear of Death
presentations.summary: Deeper in the laboratory, a recording showed its director shooting a researcher, and Shale found that Calyx watches you through the city's cameras. On a terminal Calyx invited you to the Meso Terminal, where the device holding his memories waits, and vowed to go on converting Alexandrians until you come. Krile says the key began as a Milalla relic.

citations.title: A Calculated Evolution — main scenario quest (7.3)

presentations.name: The Fear of Death
presentations.summary: Before the assault, Gossan admitted he wears an unregistered neo regulator, and Malachite's neighbors joined Oblivion to sway the wavering. Gossan removed his regulator, and Mahuwsa told Sphene that, though she is not the late queen, she is an Alexandrian. Sphene showed her face and promised to return, as Y'shtola found the Meso Terminal's wall opened for you.

citations.title: One of Our Own — main scenario quest (7.3)

presentations.name: The Fear of Death
presentations.summary: At the Meso Terminal's peak Calyx summoned the primal Necron from Alexandria's fear of death. Sphene broadcast a message of hope that broke the prayers feeding it, Alisaie dealt the killing blow, and your strike destroyed the memory bank as Calyx winked out of existence. Wuk Lamat collapsed, and every neo regulator wearer has fallen under the primal's sway.

citations.title: A Terminal Invitation — main scenario quest (7.3)

presentations.name: The Fear of Death
presentations.summary: The enthralled are in care, and Alisaie expects them to recover with treatment, while arcane practitioners are recruited to help. Mahuwsa thanked you for stopping Calyx, though Sphene fears her return would unsettle those who do not know of it. Gulool Ja, unsure he wants the throne, will train with the Landsguard so he might wield his father's and Otis's swords.

citations.title: Blades in Waiting — main scenario quest (7.3)

presentations.name: The Fear of Death
presentations.summary: Oblivion found that memories of the dead were only locked away, and with Gossan and a recovered Wuk Lamat you restored them from Living Memory for all who consented. At the people's insistence Sphene accepted the role of Queen of Reason, and Wuk Lamat has kept her promise to the Endless Sphene. Yet Calyx still exists, reporting his failure to an Ascian for his Winterer peers.

citations.title: The Promise of Tomorrow — main scenario quest (7.3)

citations.title: Toward Trouble — main scenario quest (7.4)

presentations.name: The Doomtrain
presentations.summary: A war vehicle of Lindblum with an arcane entity in its engine, brought to a halt on the rails as you fought it from a flatcar behind Lumull's locomotive. Its entourage of beasts is destroyed.

presentations.summary: An Ascian, disguised in Treno as a frantic woman, who carries Calyx's new doll-like form. Now that Calyx has failed, she says, the Ninth is doomed unless the hero changes course, and the Winterers must be ready to outlast a great withering to come.

citations.title: Into the Mist — main scenario quest (7.4)

presentations.name: Halmarut
presentations.summary: Halmarut of the Ascians, who gave Calyx his knowledge of summoning and the reflections. Since Hydaelyn's passing, she says, the sundered star seeks to rejoin its shards, ending in the Solstice that will erase mankind. She recruited the Winterers to rejoin worlds first, so that some survive.

citations.title: A Beacon from Beyond — main scenario quest (7.5)

presentations.name: Halmarut
presentations.summary: An Ascian, in the Fourth with Calyx, a world Calyx says she is bound to. Her motives differ from Lahabrea's and the other unsundered, but her objective is the Rejoining; asked whether she would rather go by her true name, she said Halmarut will do.

citations.title: Windborne — main scenario quest (7.56)

presentations.name: Malphas
